hold_text: Edits the self-landing steps of .github/workflows/research-queue-replenish.yml and research-queue-dispatch.yml (results batch + dispatch stamps); the manager merges.
why: WHY: replenish PR #27507 self-landed at 22:30:41Z while pytest-run was still running (legitimately: pytest-run is report-only since the operator's 2026-11-12 decision; branch protection requires only guards), then pytest-run failed on tests/test_research_queue.py (generated RQ-20261119-031 had no power.sd) and main went red. WHAT (manager decision, producer-side validation): new scripts/ci/validate_before_land.py runs the tests that read what a producer writes on its generated, uncommitted tree; ok=false gates the producer's commit-to-main step, so a FAIL lands nothing that run, files ONE deduplicated pipeline item 'PRODUCER VALIDATION FAILED [<producer>]' (best effort, never raised) and exits 0 (no red run, no halt; the next scheduled run retries). Wired into replenish (strict), the results batch landing and the dispatch-stamp landing (both --baseline-ref BASE_SHA: a failure that also fails on the base is main's own red and does not hold them back; for stamps this is load-bearing because an unlanded stamp re-fires its unit). land job timeout 25 -> 40 for the two validations. tests/test_research_queue_dispatch_fire_gate.py's exact stamp-if pin now allows exactly one extra conjunct (the validation verdict). Merge-side: nothing changes; pytest-run stays report-only, branch protection untouched. Gates this adds or changes: none (producer-side validation; no merge-side block; respects PYTEST-RUN-REQUIRED: REPORT-ONLY).
